name: tresillo-kick
description: The 3+3+2 tresillo on the kick: beats 1, the and-of-2, and 4 (0-indexed 0, 1.5, 3). The rhythmic cell underlying habanera, reggaeton (dembow), and a great deal of contemporary Latin-influenced pop. SCOPE: single-bar cell only — the two-bar son/rumba claves are a recorded follow-on (this library matches within one bar).
